name: Healer Jellyfish
role: The gentle boss. Slow and glowing; a calm, team-up fight.
home: Center; rises from the bottom, sinks back at the end
habit: Pulses: rises, holds, rises again. Trails baby jellies (small, low pay).
rules: Bosses own the stage: no big fish, the big-fish clock waits.
Mediums only as escorts; small fish keep 0.15 away from the boss.
The boss spends equal time near top, bottom, left and right seats.
It never leaves before the scene ends (minus 4 s).
phases: Lantern drift past each seat column
